top_signals.title: STG drayage drivers to get cash in NJ misclassification case
top_signals.summary:
STG Logistics drivers in New Jersey will be able to receive a payout for misclassification.

top_signals.title: Hackers steal 31,000 records identifying people behind Liechtenstein companies, foundations
top_signals.summary: A cyberattack compromised tens of thousands of records related to companies, foundations and trusts in Liechtenstein, prompting the government to to form a “crisis unit” to address the breach.
